task.title: Review page performance: slow navigation to the planner and grocery list
task.description:
Moving around the app feels laggy. Sometimes the planner page or the grocery list takes a long time to show up. Seen on the dev deployment; not yet known whether the cause is that deployment (Render or Convex cold starts, plan limits) or the app itself.

Find out where the time goes before changing anything:
- Measure navigation to the planner and the grocery list on dev and on production, first visit and repeat visits.
- Separate page load (Next.js server render, bundle size, Render instance waking up) from data load (Convex query time, number of queries and documents read per page).
- Check the planner and grocery list queries for reads that grow with history, missing indexes and queries that run one after another.
- Check whether pages show a loading state at once or stay blank until data arrives.

Done when the causes are listed with measurements and each has either a fix or a follow-up story.
